description: Aroha task-mandate v2 conformance vectors. Canonicalisation is RFC 8785 (JCS). A v2 task-mandate signature is Ed25519(privateKey, UTF-8(JCS({"mandate": <body>, "purpose": "aroha.task-mandate/v2", "v": 2}))), base64url without padding; a legacy v1 signature covers JSON.stringify(sortKeys(body)). Tokens are base64url(JSON({v: 2, mandate, signature})) and carry one link. Every verdict, reason and code below was computed by the TypeScript reference (verifyTaskMandate with options.now, checkTaskNarrowing, checkTaskConstraints). Public keys resolve from content-addressed DIDs (did:aroha:z<base58btc(pubkey)>). Keys are the RFC 8032 section 7.1 test keys - never use them for anything real.
